payload.description: The documented pnpm run benchmark:run command builds TypeScript and executes dist/tests/benchmark/run-benchmark.js. DEFAULT_BENCHMARK_ROOT currently derives from __dirname, so the compiled runner searches for manifests under dist/tests/benchmark/repos/, but the YAML manifests and annotations remain under tests/benchmark/repos/ and are not copied by the build. Reproduction on PR #3 at 30ec0d2: pnpm run benchmark:run --include-proposed vgs-django easy-school exits with Missing manifest at .../dist/tests/benchmark/repos/vgs-django/manifest.yaml before scanning. Resolve the runtime metadata root robustly from the repository/project root or deliberately copy corpus assets as part of the build. Add a process-level or command-level test exercising the actual built CLI path without an injected benchmarkRoot, and prove benchmark:run reaches scanning with a materialized fixture. Keep execution independent of the caller working directory where practical.
payload.title: Resolve benchmark metadata root after TypeScript build
